title: The Boy Who Shared His Last Date
source_detail: Verse about those who feed the poor
description: A hungry boy faces a choice: keep his last date for himself or share it with a friend. Discover how his generous heart brings more blessings than he could imagine.

pages.text: Once upon a time, in a peaceful little village, lived a boy named Amin. Amin had a heart full of kindness.
pages.illustration_prompt: A vibrant, welcoming village scene with lush green trees and cozy homes. Amin, a small boy with big curious eyes, stands among colorful flowers, smiling warmly.

pages.text: One sunny afternoon, Amin found a single sweet date in his pocket. It was his favorite treat.
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin looks down at a shiny date in his small hand, sunlight glistening on its surface. He smiles with joy, surrounded by a backdrop of warm golden hues.

pages.text: Amin felt hungry, but he knew his friend Samir was even hungrier. What could he do?
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin stands at a crossroads, pondering. On one side, the path leads to his friend Samir, who looks hopeful. Deep blues and warm sunset colors surround them.

pages.text: Amin thought of the verse from the Quran about sharing with those in need. His heart felt light.
pages.illustration_prompt: A soft silhouette of a Prophet is seen reading a glowing Quran under a grand tree. Amin imagines this scene, with leaves fluttering in soft pink and orange hues.

pages.text: Amin decided to share his last date with Samir. He knew it was the right thing to do.
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin and Samir sit together on a colorful blanket under the shade of a lush, green tree. Amin is splitting the date into two, both boys smiling warmly.

pages.text: Samir was surprised and happy. "Thank you, Amin!" he said with a big grin.
pages.illustration_prompt: Samir joyfully takes his half of the date, his eyes sparkling with gratitude. The background is a vibrant mix of blues and greens, creating a magical atmosphere.

pages.text: As Amin shared, he felt a warmth inside, like a soft, glowing light in his heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin's chest glows with a warm golden light, surrounded by a gentle halo. The scene is framed by soft pink clouds and a calming sunset.

pages.text: Suddenly, a gentle breeze blew and more dates fell from the tree above.
pages.illustration_prompt: Golden dates gently falling around the boys, carried by a playful breeze. The tree is full of life, painted in lush greens with golden highlights.

pages.text: Amin and Samir laughed with joy, gathering the dates into their small hands.
pages.illustration_prompt: Both boys eagerly collect the dates, their eyes wide with wonder and delight. The scene is vibrant with colors of happiness and abundance.

pages.text: Amin learned that sharing brings unexpected blessings, filling the heart with happiness.
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin and Samir sit under the tree, surrounded by dates, sharing happily. The atmosphere is cozy and warm, with deep blues and oranges in the sky.

pages.text: The sun began to set, painting the sky with shades of orange and pink.
pages.illustration_prompt: A breathtaking sunset with streaks of orange and pink, the boys silhouetted against this magical backdrop, their faces filled with peace.

pages.text: As they watched the sunset, Amin felt grateful for the beautiful day.
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin reflects on the day, his eyes soft and serene. He sits close to Samir, the warm glow of the sunset enveloping them both.

pages.text: "Thank you for sharing with me," said Samir, "You're a wonderful friend."
pages.illustration_prompt: Samir expresses his gratitude, his eyes sincere and warm. The boys are surrounded by a peaceful, inviting setting with gentle colors.

pages.text: Amin smiled, feeling the goodness of his choice. "Allah loves those who share," he thought.
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin's face is filled with contentment, his thoughts glowing like little stars above him. The scene is peaceful, with soft pink and golden hues.

pages.text: Soon, it was time to go home. The village lights twinkled softly in the evening.
pages.illustration_prompt: The village is cozy and inviting, with little lights flickering in the windows. Amin and Samir walk home, hand in hand, under a sky full of stars.

pages.text: As Amin tucked into bed, he felt calm and happy. He whispered, "Goodnight, world."
pages.illustration_prompt: Amin snuggled in his bed, a serene expression on his face. The room is softly lit, with a gentle moonlight coming through the window, creating a perfect bedtime scene.
